notes.title: Notice: Known Issue
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing Memory Girl+.

We would like to inform you about a known issue: when saving, the save slot may display the message "No Saved Data Available." However, this does not affect the actual save data, and reopening the save screen will display the correct information. This issue does not impact gameplay progression.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Our team is working on a fix, and we appreciate your patience as we prepare an update.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy Memory Girl+!

— Champloo Games

notes.title: Memory Girl+ Release in Q1 2025
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We want to extend our deepest gratitude to all of you for your continued enthusiasm and support for Memory Girl+. Our team has been working tirelessly to bring you the best possible gaming experience, but after careful consideration, we have decided to delay the release date.

The new release date is now set for [b]early winter of 2025.[/b] This extra time will allow us to polish the game further and ensure it meets the high standards you expect and deserve. This also allows us to incorporate the feedback we received during the Next Fest free demo trials.

We understand that delays can be disappointing, and we genuinely appreciate your patience and understanding. Our top priority is delivering a game that lives up to your expectations and provides an unforgettable experience.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. We can’t wait for you to experience Memory Girl+ soon!

Sincerely,
Champloo Games

=====
Don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/ChamplooGames]Publisher Page[/url] and our [url=https://x.com/ChamplooGames]Twitter[/url] to stay up-to-date with what Champloo Games has to offer!
Thank you for your support and we hope you'll enjoy our upcoming releases!
